title: DOW-UAP-PR33, Unresolved UAP Report, Syria, October 2024
doc_notes: This document is a declassified USCENTCOM Mission Report (MISREP) detailing an ISR mission in Syria on October 20, 2024, which includes a specific UAP incident report involving FMV sensor observations.

incidents.summary: Aircrew observed multiple light/glare phenomena, including a misshapen and uneven ball of white light, crossing the FMV camera feed during an ISR mission.
incidents.quote: MISHAPEN AND UNEVEN BALL OF WHITE LIGHT.
